newsitem.title: USA: Novadigm says gets Internet "push" patent.
newsitem.headline: Novadigm says gets Internet "push" patent.

text.p: Novadigm Inc on Monday said it received a patent for its proprietary processes used in Internet "push-pull" technology, where customized information is directly broadcast to networked personal computers.

Novadigm's patent describes the processes needed to generate unique reference information for each target end user and to 'difference' the model with the actual-state of the target, yielding very specific updates to distributed content automatically, they said.
Key elements of the technology protected by the patent are already employed by users of Novadigm's software management product, Enterprise Desktop Manager, they added.
The firm said it plans to expand its licensing progam to include the patented processes.
